query.sql: SELECT * FROM (SELECT "$when" AS timestamp, "$producer" AS freezer_id, CAST(json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.temperature') AS REAL) AS temperature_c, CAST(json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.compressor_current_amps') AS REAL) AS compressor_amps, json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.door_open') AS door_open FROM v_messages WHERE "$type" = 'FreezerTelemetry' ORDER BY "$when" DESC LIMIT 50) ORDER BY timestamp ASC

SELECT "$when" AS assessed_at, json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.target_producer') AS target_freezer, json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.risk_level') AS risk_level, CAST(json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.estimated_minutes_to_spoilage') AS INTEGER) AS mins_to_spoilage, json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.root_cause_prediction') AS root_cause, json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.recommended_action_code') AS action_code FROM v_messages WHERE "$type" = 'StorageRiskAssessment' ORDER BY "$when" DESC LIMIT 20
